command_plan.acceptance_focus: pairing is visible and diagnostic, not connected steady

command_plan.name: ble_reconnect
command_plan.label: BLE reconnect

command_plan.acceptance_focus: reconnect is visible without becoming a permanent lamp

command_plan.name: rec_capture
command_plan.label: REC active
command_plan.expected: REC is the strongest routine status while proven capture/upload is active
command_plan.acceptance_focus: REC only lights for capture/upload or preview command

command_plan.name: rec_unavailable_warn
command_plan.label: WARN + REC unavailable
command_plan.expected: capture unavailable is represented as WARN plus REC companion, not active REC alone
command_plan.acceptance_focus: unavailable capture maps to WARN + REC

command_plan.name: ai_processing
command_plan.label: AI processing

command_plan.acceptance_focus: AI timing is camera-measured and settles for long processing

command_plan.name: ai_processing_settled

command_plan.acceptance_focus: AI long processing settles rather than escalating indefinitely

command_plan.name: ok_success

command_plan.acceptance_focus: WARN amber severity with source pairing

command_plan.name: warn_hard
command_plan.label: WARN hard
command_plan.expected: hard warning uses red WARN and source pairing
command_plan.acceptance_focus: WARN red hard severity with source pairing

command_plan.name: charging

command_plan.acceptance_focus: charging is visible without a permanent bright lamp
